description: Use this WHENEVER the user states or asks you to verify a numeric macro claim (inflation, GDP, interest rates): settle it against the claim's OWN country's authoritative series instead of answering from memory, which risks the wrong jurisdiction (e.g. U.S. CPI for a Czech claim). Binds the claim to a jurisdiction (CZ, DE, ...) and returns a cited above/below verdict. Deterministic and offline.

resolve_by.description: ISO date the claim resolves by, e.g. 2022-12-31

name: resolve_country_claim
title: Resolve Country Macro Claim
